hints.title: Bounded Knapsack Modeling
hints.text: This is a bounded knapsack problem where each question type provides marks up to count times.

hints.title: Reverse Iteration for Exact Use
hints.text: Iterate backwards from target down to 0 to prevent counting multiple uses of the same question type within one step.

hints.title: Inner Multiple Count Loop
hints.text: For each current score s, sum dp[s - c * marks] for all valid c from 1 up to count.

hints.title: Bounded Knapsack DP Implementation

complexity.notes: 1D dynamic programming table updated backwards per question type.
complexity.whyNaiveFails: Recursive exploration of all count combinations takes exponential time.
complexity.interviewerExpectation: Implements bounded knapsack dynamic programming modulo 10^9 + 7.
